trimmingSuggestions.description: While informative, the prolonged use of static visuals for the statistics could be condensed using more dynamic on-screen graphics or quicker cuts.
This segment, while important, feels a bit repetitive regarding the 2020 goals. It could be shortened by combining key points.

text_to_speech: Hi, I'm Anna Vainer. I am the founder of I Am Remarkable. I am Remarkable is the global movement that helps women and underrepresented groups celebrate their achievements both in work and beyond. We have reached 100 000 people across more than 100 countries with the help of 5000 facilitators. One key stat that is really important for us is that we've reached over 500 companies that have implemented I am Remarkable within their orgs. And it's not just about the reach. It's also about the impact that we were able to bring. We do a survey right after the workshop and we do a survey three months after the workshop. And the results are pretty amazing. 82% of people after attending the I am Remarkable workshop feel more confident about themselves. 72% of people actually say that they practice more self promotion. And the stat that I'm most proud of is that 49% of people said that thanks to the I am Remarkable workshop, they were able to get a pay rise, to get a new job, to get a promotion or to start a new business. 2019 was a great year. We appeared on large stages like Web Summit and Ted and DMEXCO. In 2020 we're going to do even more. We're going to reach 200 000 people all over the world, and we're going to do it with your help and with the help of new facilitators that are going to be joining us this year. Thank you so much, and stay remarkable.

youtube_description:
#IamRemarkable has reached 100,000 participants from across 100+ countries, with the help of 5,000 facilitators. Anna Vainer, the founder of #IamRemarkable, talks about this milestone and the impact that the initiative has on the life of thousands of people around the world.

#IamRemarkable is a Google initiative empowering women and underrepresented groups to celebrate their achievements in the workplace and beyond.
